Name: Buy Qi Gems with Qi Coins
Author: SnPie
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Buy Qi Gems with Qi Coins at the Casino after unlocking Qi’s Walnut Room. [/color]
[line]
[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
1. Install [b]SMAPI 4.5.0 or later[/b].
2. Download Qi Coin Gem Exchange and extract the archive.
3. Place the [b]Qi Coin Gem Exchange[/b] folder inside your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.
[line]
[b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Four price [/color][color=#d4d4d8]presets: 2,500 / 5,000 / 10,000 / 20,000 Qi Coins per Qi Gem[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Custom message and next-day invitation letter[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Optional GMCM support[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ff7700][size=4][b]English [/b][/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8]and [/color][color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Korean [/b][/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8]support[/color]
[/*]
[*]first spoiler:
[spoiler] Enter Qi’s Walnut Room and check the notification message.[/spoiler]
[/*]
[*]second spoiler: 
[spoiler] Check your mailbox the day after visiting Qi’s Walnut Room.[/spoiler]
[/*]
[*]third spoiler: 
[spoiler] The Casino merchant now sells Qi Gems[/spoiler]
[/*]
[/list][line]
[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Required[/b]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.5.0 or later.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#d4d4d8]Optional[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] ( Not strictly required, but highly recommended)[/color]
-  Generic Mod Config Menu : Allows you to change the mod settings through an in-game configuration menu.[/*]
[/list][line]
